title: learning_block's trace-name proof counts only its skill readers
intention: learning_block's trace-name proof stops importing CodeMother's clearance and counts only its three skill readers over either store, so a machine's proof measures only what it may reach.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: cairn/machines/learning_block/proofs/test_a_trace_file_name_is_legal_on_every_box.py:127, in clause 4 of ticket a9709b744bf5, imports cairn.devices.codemother.machines.clearance and counts read_attempts. That is a machine's proof measuring a device's reader (RULE 1). encapsulation_holds does not see it, because it checks only device-to-device imports. Ticket 20f7a78faaa5 now proves that count at clearance's own address.
traces_to: RULE 1 — a ticket's proofs measure only its own component.
how: Remove the clearance import, count, seed lines and assert from clause 4; add an AST tooth over every learning_block proof's imports that reds any under cairn.devices.

clauses.claim: no proof under cairn/machines/learning_block/proofs imports anything under cairn.devices, read by AST
clause 4 counts exactly the intent, sorted and saveslate readers, the same over a legacy-named store and a new-name store

decisions.text: D1: clause 4 drops the clearance reader; a new tooth scans learning_block's proofs' imports by AST; PROVES maps this ticket's clauses to the new tooth and to clause 4.

measured.saw: the only import of cairn.devices in cairn/machines/learning_block is the proof's :127 clearance import
the AST tooth red over the house tree at :127; the narrowed proof green 6/6
measured.how: in-process run with REPO at the house tree, read-only; bin/cairn test --exec in worktree wt-lbn
